name: manual_9b3602
claim: Use GitHub REST to reply to review comments with applicable pull-request write permission; resolve or unresolve threads through GraphQL resolveReviewThread/unresolveReviewThread or a verified connector, and use the UI when that capability is unavailable. A prior contents-write-only token failed REST replies with 403 while GraphQL resolution succeeded; that is historical scoped evidence, not a universal bypass or proof of a REST resolution route. Fetch independent refs so a missing ref cannot silently suppress publication, rebuild missing test environments with their extras and verify imported module paths, lint prose, and triage rate-limit/own-reply/green notices without inventing findings.

decisions.notes: Review 5476411379 is valid: GitHub REST documents replies, while thread resolution is GraphQL. Official docs verified on 2026-10-10 Asia/Manila. Preserve original graduated candidate and historical JSONL rows; supersede unsupported REST resolution guidance. Historical lesson_c2cfa44e28df is token-specific evidence, not a universal permission promise.
